# Ayman Boujjar

> Full-stack and mobile developer in Casablanca, Morocco. Laravel and React web applications; React Native and Expo apps for iOS and Android. Available for remote freelance and contract work worldwide.

## Profile

- [About Ayman](https://aymanboujjar.com/about): background, education, experience, and current role as Full Stack Developer at LionsGeek Association.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/aymanboujjar): public developer profile.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aymanboujjar): professional profile.
- [CV](https://aymanboujjar.com/Ayman_Boujjar_CV.pdf): downloadable résumé.

## Services

- [Full-stack development](https://aymanboujjar.com/services/full-stack-development): Laravel, React, Inertia, TypeScript, and Tailwind web applications, community platforms, and internal tools.
- [Laravel development](https://aymanboujjar.com/services/laravel-development): backend systems, APIs, data-driven features, and integrations with web and mobile clients.
- [Mobile app development](https://aymanboujjar.com/services/mobile-app-development): React Native and Expo applications for iOS and Android, including backend integration.
- [All services](https://aymanboujjar.com/services): service overview and supporting projects.

## Selected case studies

- [Tilila](https://aymanboujjar.com/project/Tilila): media platform for CPD / 2M, combining awards, mentoring, and an expert directory. Full-stack contributor with the LionsGeek team.
- [MyLionsGeek](https://aymanboujjar.com/project/MyLionsGeek): community and operations platform with posts, messaging, jobs, and reservations. Full-stack developer with the LionsGeek team.
- [LionsGeek Mobile](https://aymanboujjar.com/project/LionsGeek-Mobile): React Native / Expo community app for iOS and Android. Mobile developer with the LionsGeek team; store links appear in the case study.
- [Casatourat](https://aymanboujjar.com/project/Casatourat): React Native / Expo cultural heritage guide for Casa Mémoire, with GPS-based tours and a Laravel API. Mobile app developer working with LionsGeek / Casa Mémoire.
- [Ada Lovelace](https://aymanboujjar.com/project/Ada-Lovelace): conversational 3D avatar developed with LionsGeek. The team received the Jury’s Coup de Cœur at [IN]VISIBLE Festival 2026 in Brussels. Ayman contributed the 3D avatar and Moroccan Darija integration.
- [Project collection](https://aymanboujjar.com/projects): complete portfolio and additional case studies.
